idx_reservations_unlinked_retention.name: idx_reservations_unlinked_retention
idx_reservations_unlinked_retention.where: "reservations"."guest_id" is null and "reservations"."erased" = false and ("reservations"."guest_name" <> '' or "reservations"."guest_contact" <> '' or "reservations"."commentary" <> '')

self_service_links_cancel_revoked.name: self_service_links_cancel_revoked
self_service_links_cancel_revoked.value: "self_service_links"."cancel_key" IS NULL OR "self_service_links"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL

services_party_size_limits.name: services_party_size_limits
services_party_size_limits.value: ("services"."min_party_size" IS NULL OR "services"."min_party_size" >= 1) AND ("services"."max_party_size" IS NULL OR "services"."max_party_size" >= 1) AND ("services"."min_party_size" IS NULL OR "services"."max_party_size" IS NULL OR "services"."min_party_size" <= "services"."max_party_size")

venue_online_booking_party.name: venue_online_booking_party
venue_online_booking_party.value: "venue_online_booking"."min_party_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "venue_online_booking"."max_party_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "venue_online_booking"."min_party_size" <= "venue_online_booking"."max_party_size"

venue_online_booking_weekdays.name: venue_online_booking_weekdays
venue_online_booking_weekdays.value: "venue_online_booking"."weekdays" IS NULL OR (cardinality("venue_online_booking"."weekdays") BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND "venue_online_booking"."weekdays" <@ ARRAY[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]::smallint[])

venues_public_geo.name: venues_public_geo
venues_public_geo.value: ("venues"."public_latitude" IS NULL) = ("venues"."public_longitude" IS NULL) AND ("venues"."public_latitude" IS NULL OR ("venues"."public_latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "venues"."public_longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180))

waitlist_window.name: waitlist_window
waitlist_window.value: ("waitlist"."window_start" IS NULL AND "waitlist"."window_end" IS NULL) OR ("waitlist"."window_start" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' AND "waitlist"."window_end" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' AND "waitlist"."window_start" < "waitlist"."window_end")

waitlist_widget_entry.name: waitlist_widget_entry
waitlist_widget_entry.value: "waitlist"."source" = 'staff' OR ("waitlist"."date" IS NOT NULL AND "waitlist"."consent_at" IS NOT NULL)

waitlist_links_leave_revoked.name: waitlist_links_leave_revoked
waitlist_links_leave_revoked.value: "waitlist_links"."leave_key" IS NULL OR "waitlist_links"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL
